text.en: This Order m ay be cited as the Brunei Economic Development Board Act (Amendment) Order, 2003 · lnsertion of n ew section ll A into Chapter 104 ·

The Brunei Economic Development Board Act is amended by inserting the following new section immediately after section ll "Audit. IIA · ( 1 ) The accounts of the Board shall be audited at least once annually (a ) the Auditor General; or (b ) any person who has been authorised to perform the duties required by the Companies Act (Chapter 39 ) to be performed by an auditor, who shall be appointed annually by the Board, who shall submit a report thereon to His Majesty the SuItan and Yang Di-Pertuan in Council. 《 2 ) Where the accounts of the Board have been audited by a person appointed under paragraph (b ) of subsection (1), the report referred to in that subsection may be verified by the Auditor General before it is submitted pursuant to subsection ( ) to His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan in CounciI. " 85

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE Made this 21st. day of Muharam, 1424 Hijriah corresponding to the 24th. day of Marchf 2003 at O ur lstana Nurul lman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM 86
